items.headline: Army to move forward with lead azide detonation in Iowa on Wednesday following court ruling
items.summary: Acting Army Sec. Adam Telle said the detonation will take place at some point on Wednesday morning.

items.headline: Southeast Iowa livestock farmers testing for lead ahead of Middletown detonation
items.summary: An animal feed delivery company is handing out lead test strips to its customers to get a baseline reading on water used for animals.

items.headline: East Moline School District names new superintendent
items.summary: Carl Johnson will take over the role on July 1, 2027, following the retirement of Kristin Humphries, who led the district for 17 years.

items.headline: Army lead azide detonation set for Wednesday after court lifts stay on EPA permit
items.summary: The Army has postponed its planned lead azide detonation at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant until Wednesday.

items.headline: Army's planned lead azide detonation set for Wednesday after court lifts stay
items.summary: A federal judge has said the U.S. Army can move forward with detonating 68 barrels, or nearly five tons, of lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant.

items.headline: Illinois state agencies launch informational site on Iowa Army Ammunition Plant detonation
items.summary: Due to the plant being located on the Iowa-Illinois border, several state agencies in Illinois have been keeping an eye on the planned lead azide detonation.

items.headline: 50 years of second chances: Safer Foundation celebrates Quad Cities milestone
items.summary: The local nonprofit helps people adjust to life after incarceration and works to reduce recidivism. You can celebrate with a free event on Dec. 1.

items.headline: Gov. Reynolds orders flags to half-staff in honor of Wally E. Horn
items.summary: Horn served for 46 consecutive years in the Iowa Legislature and is Iowa's longest-serving legislator.
